### BRK_beta is deliberately missing its own closing brace (the `if` and
### `completion_reward` blocks close, but the enclosing `focus = {` never
### does). The structured pass swallows BRK_gamma as a nested child of
### BRK_beta instead of a sibling; the per-focus brace-walk fallback
### recovers all three focuses independently. ###

focus_tree = {
	id = BRK_tree

	focus = {
		id = BRK_alpha
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 5
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = BRK_beta
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 1
		y = 0
		cost = 5
		completion_reward = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_war = yes }
				add_political_power = 5
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = BRK_gamma
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 2
		y = 0
		cost = 5
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 15
		}
	}
}
